newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan adjusts rupee lower against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan adjusts rupee lower against dollar.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan on Friday adjusted the rupee lower to 40.5200/40.7226 to the dollar from 40.4600/40.6623 fixed on June 28, the bank said.
The bank gave no reason for the depreciation but a leading money changer said it was a technical correction. "The rupee was adjusted lower due to a technical correction," dealer Ovais Kalia said.
The dollar had gained on international markets and the rupee was depreciated against it, he said.
The depreciation was the first for the 1997/98 (July-June) financial year, he said.
